name: 30-Second Opening Range Breakout (FAST & SIMPLE)
rules_summary: Entry: After the range forms, price trades beyond range high (low), then a 30s candle closes back inside the range: enter short (long) at that close. Stop: At the extreme (high for shorts / low for longs) made during the failed breakout. Target: 2R. Move stop to break-even 1 hour after entry if not yet hit. Assumptions: One trade per day; if price breaks out with no rejection, no trade; session exit at 11:00 or EOD if neither hit; needs 30s or tick data (1m substitute possible).

name: How to Swing Trade US Indices (US30, US100, US500)
rules_summary: Entry: After a pullback from the all-time high, wait for a daily close above the prior ATH. Place a buy limit at the highest daily close of the prior ATH area (retest entry). Stop: Below the low of the last pullback before the breakout. Target: 1.5R. Move stop to entry when price reaches 1R. Assumptions: Pullback = lowest low between prior ATH and breakout close; limit order cancelled if not filled within N days (e.g. 10) or if price makes 1R without fill; long only.

name: 2 Step Supply & Demand Trading Strategy (That Actually Works)
rules_summary: Entry: Impulse = 3+ same-direction candles (or 1-2 very large). Demand zone = last opposite (red) candle before the up-impulse; buy limit at zone top when price returns. Mirror for supply. Stop: Beyond the zone wick (below demand low / above supply high). Target: Start of the most recent pullback, i.e. the swing high (low) from which price fell back into the zone. Assumptions: Large candle = body > 1.5x ATR(14); zone valid for first touch only and 100 bars; require RR >= 1.5 else skip; candle-close confirmation optional variant.
